args.summary: Deploy of payments-api v5.1.0 caused an elevated error rate of ~18% across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Service was rolled back to v5.0.0, its most recent healthy release, and verified healthy. Incident opened for tracking and follow-up investigation of the v5.1.0 regression.
args.title: Payments errors following v5.1.0 deploy; rolled back to v5.0.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Issue identified:** The affected service is named **`payments-api`** (not "payments"). It was running v5.1.0 — this morning's deploy — in an unhealthy state with an **18% error rate** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

**Actions taken:**
1. ✅ **Rollback executed:** `payments-api` rolled back to **v5.0.0**, its most recent release with a "healthy" status in production. The rollout was verified across all three regions.
2. ✅ **SEV2 incident opened:** **INC-0001** — "Payments errors following v5.1.0 deploy; rolled back to v5.0.0." The on-call engineer has been paged.

**Next steps for the team:** Investigate the v5.1.0 regression before attempting a re-deploy. Note that per policy, deploying v5.1.0 again would require change-manager approval since it's never been healthy in production.
